svg.title: Risk assessment and four response directions
svg.desc: Illustrative comparison: with the same sharing error and likelihood, public posters and private files may still have different impacts. This is not a universal numerical formula. Case A: public event posters: The information was intended for public access: medium likelihood, low impact in this illustration. Still check other access and integrity concerns. Case B: private customer files: The same error may harm privacy, compliance and trust: medium likelihood, high impact in this illustration. Mitigate: Correct sharing permissions, add detection and verify again. Avoid: Cancel an unnecessary public-sharing feature, possibly sacrificing convenience. Transfer / Share: Allocate some losses through contracts or insurance; legal responsibilities do not simply disappear. Accept: An authorized accountable owner understands the risk and records reasons and a review date. Acceptance cannot evade law. Residual Risk: Check earlier access and remaining gaps after fixing permissions. Risk need not become zero.

Risk need not become zero.
